scope: All checked-out design/bloom files, client/public files, reachable local runtime imports from client entry and index.html, and current dist/public build. Type-only imports excluded; literal lazy imports are potential reachability.
limits: Exact string references are candidates, not proof of rendering. Public files are shipped even when unreferenced.
Computed imports are reported; package internals, browser cache, conditional activation and computed public URLs are not fully resolved.
Concept/CSS adaptation cannot be inferred by equal bytes. Design-only reference does not mean unused or disposable. No deletions recommended.
No authenticated hosted resource trace or independent Design/licence approval is asserted.
